title: SB401 (2026 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Conference Draft 2, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2026/bills/SB401_CD2_.HTM; sha256 fb3845575e6e6fbb49e63aab8c52374f860ff9cb339360d04fc89ad5e0a0bbdf)
provenance.note: Conference Draft 2 of SB 401 as printed in the 2026 session. Conference Draft 2 (CD2), the text both houses took to final reading; not proof of enactment. Senate passed SD2 20-5 (2025-03-04) and House passed 39-8 (2025-04-04); amendments after the version read are not in the text read. Quotes skip sentences that run across struck text. Also in the bill: SECTION 3 (HRS 134-8(c)) keeps a ban on manufacture, possession, sale or transfer of detachable magazines over ten rounds, now covering any firearm rather than only pistols (the bill strikes the word 'pistol'); SECTION 1 adds definitions of assault rifle, assault shotgun, .50 caliber firearm, detachable and fixed magazine; effective 1/1/2026.
